pipeline.asset: Alpha DaRT (Diffusing Alpha-emitter Radiation Therapy) — DaRT224 (Radium-224) intratumoral source
pipeline.modality: Intratumoral interstitial brachytherapy device — Radium-224-loaded source releasing short-range alpha-emitting daughter atoms inside the tumor
pipeline.target: Solid tumor DNA double-strand breaks (alpha-particle radiation, ~2-3 mm diffusion radius)
pipeline.license_origin: Internal (founded on technology from Tel Aviv University)

indications.indication: Recurrent cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (cSCC) — patients not candidates for surgery or standard radiation
indications.highest_phase: Pivotal (FDA Phase NA — device study; FDA Breakthrough Device Designation; PMA module 1 submitted Jan 2026)
indications.trial_name: ReSTART (Recurrent SCC Treatment with Alpha DaRT Radiation Therapy)
indications.trial_design: Multi-center, single-arm pivotal trial assessing efficacy and safety of intratumoral Alpha DaRT in recurrent cSCC; up to 86 patients enrolled in US, Canada, Europe and Israel.
indications.trial_status: Recruiting (enrollment completion targeted end of Q1 2026); first module of PMA submitted to FDA Jan 2026
key_milestones: First two patients treated in pivotal cohort

indications.indication: Cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma — immunocompromised patients
indications.trial_design: Company-sponsored interventional study of Alpha DaRT224 in immunocompromised patients with cutaneous SCC.

indications.trial_name: DaRT + Checkpoint Inhibitor in Recurrent HNSCC
indications.trial_design: Company-sponsored interventional study of intratumoral Alpha DaRT + immune checkpoint inhibitor in recurrent HNSCC.
